title: Ezra co-brand lockup
description: A two-name wordmark: a small mark and a light sans partner name, a thin vertical hairline, then the brand name in a heavier lowercase. Plain text, no logo art; sizes from the caller.
notes: the partner half is optional: alone it is a single wordmark
name: ezra-lockup

props.name: name
props.description: the brand's name, set heavier in lowercase

props.name: partner
props.description: a partner name shown first, light, with a hairline between

props.name: mark
props.description: a small mark before the first name (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: className
props.description: text size and colour (the lockup scales with font-size)
